dataRoles.name: invernadero
dataRoles.description: Unique identifier for each object on the canvas (e.g. A01, Table-12, Seat-05)

dataRoles.name: etiqueta
dataRoles.description: Display name shown inside each object. Defaults to Object ID if not set.

dataRoles.name: valorPrincipal
dataRoles.description: Primary numeric value. Drives the fill bar (0-100 = percentage). Optional — leave empty for status-only visuals.

dataRoles.name: campoTexto1
dataRoles.description: Categorical field used by color rules (e.g. Status, State, Category)

dataRoles.name: tooltipFields
dataRoles.description: Additional fields shown in the tooltip — drag any combination of measures, dates, or text fields. Order is preserved.

dataRoles.name: layoutX
dataRoles.description: Horizontal position on canvas (0 to Canvas_W). Set column to Don't Summarize.

dataRoles.name: layoutY
dataRoles.description: Vertical position on canvas (0 to Canvas_H). Set column to Don't Summarize.

dataRoles.name: layoutW
dataRoles.description: Object width in pixels. Set column to Don't Summarize.

dataRoles.name: layoutH
dataRoles.description: Object height in pixels. Set column to Don't Summarize.

reglasJson.description: Internal: color-rule definitions. Edit via the built-in Rules editor (gear icon).

colorFallback.description: Color used when no rule matches
